findings.title: Pinned mise-action version ignores cache_key_prefix, so the guard passes while the shared key remains
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: Speculative: it rests on the hypothesis that the pinned mise-action versions ignore cache_key_prefix, a long-standing declared input of mise-action, and cites no code showing this.

findings.title: Cold mise caches after merge slow every job and may hit job timeouts
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: Cold caches after re-keying are an expected one-off cost that self-heals; immaterial to release risk.
